item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 26/Sep/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will continue to cover southern China tomorrow. A surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China on Thursday. There will be a few showers over the region in the latter part of this week. Meanwhile, a broad area of low pressure over the central part of the South China Sea will bring unsettled weather to the region. Under the influence of a replenishment of the northeast monsoon, it will be windier with showers over the coast of Guangdong early next week.
